takeaway: The deep peroneal nerve supplies the first web space; the superficial peroneal supplies most of the dorsum, the sural the posterolateral foot, the plantar nerves the sole.

question.text: A 25-year-old gentleman sustains an injury to the common peroneal nerve while playing rugby. Which area of the foot would you touch to test the deep peroneal nerve?
question.say: A twenty-five-year-old gentleman sustains an injury to the common peroneal nerve while playing rugby. Which area of the foot would you touch to test the deep peroneal nerve?

lines.text: Rugby has injured the common peroneal nerve.
Our diver is the deep peroneal nerve, and it dives into the first web space.
So you test it by touching the skin between the big toe and the second toe.
The superficial peroneal nerve covers the anterolateral calf and most of the dorsum.
The sural nerve supplies the posterolateral calf and foot.
The medial and lateral sole belong to the medial and lateral plantar nerves.
No option names the first web space, so the answer is none of the above.
lines.say: (laugh) No option names the first web space, so the answer is none of the above.
